summary: This is the largest MAGELLAN run tracked so far (223k of a planned 500k episodes, still RUNNING). Grasp and grow_plants both saturate to 100% test SR well ahead of the paper's schedule, but grow_plants suffers 15 collapse-and-recover cycles rather than converging smoothly. Grow_herbivores and grow_carnivores show no meaningful progress by 223k episodes, and alpha has already collapsed to near-zero, which may be starving the exploration needed to crack the harder goal categories.

findings.description: test/grasp crosses 0.9 at step 5003 and reaches 1.0 by step 6010, staying at 1.0 for the rest of the run (fraction_above_last_quarter = 1.0, zero collapses).

test/grow_plants first crosses 0.9 at step 38016 (faster than paper) but then collapses back below 0.5 fifteen separate times over the remaining ~185k episodes, at least once dropping all the way to 0.0. Only 78.6% of points in the final quarter of the run are above 0.5 — this goal has not stably converged despite reaching 100% multiple times.
findings.recommendation: Inspect the grow_plants curve in the saved history file around each collapse to see if it correlates with goal-sampler reweighting away from grow_plants (LP estimate hitting the 0.01 threshold) or with SR-head/critic instability from adapter updates.

findings.description: test/grow_herbivores never exceeds 0.1 (max 0.031 at step 33011, back to 0.0 by the end). Paper's ON_TRACK window for first crossing 0.1 is 60-80k episodes; this run is already at 223k with no sustained signal, which falls in the '>100k or never' BELOW_PAPER bucket.
findings.recommendation: Check whether the grow_herbivores goal-sampler LP weight is being crowded out by grow_plants' instability, and whether grow_plants collapses are consuming replay/update budget that would otherwise go to herbivores.

findings.description: test/grow_carnivores stays at 0.0 throughout. Paper shows carnivores is the hardest goal, only starting to rise at 150-200k and still converging at 500k even for MAGELLAN. At 223k this is on the edge of expected/behind — worth watching but not alarming yet given grow_herbivores hasn't taken off either.
findings.recommendation: Re-check once this run reaches 300-350k episodes; if grow_herbivores remains flat by then, carnivores is very unlikely to start given the goal-progression dependency implied in the paper.

findings.description: SR estimate for impossible goals sits at 0.2655 at 223k episodes, above the paper's >0.20 'not learning per-goal features' threshold. It briefly touched 0.52 at step 0 then never cleanly separated impossibles from learnable goals.
findings.recommendation: Compare against the two earlier short runs in the changelog where this same value hovered near 0.34+; if it hasn't dropped after 20x more episodes, the SR head likely lacks a discriminative signal for the impossibles class rather than just needing more data.

findings.description: train/alpha decayed from a peak of 0.0498 down to 1.35e-5 (well below the 0.05 near-zero threshold), effectively collapsing SAC's temperature. Entropy itself is finite and never NaN (min 0.022, last 0.397), so this isn't the known entropy-NaN bug — it looks like a legitimate but premature temperature collapse, coinciding with grasp/grow_plants saturating while grow_herbivores/grow_carnivores remain unsolved.
findings.recommendation: Consider whether the target entropy is being satisfied by the easy goals (grasp/plants) alone, starving exploration for the harder, still-unsolved goal categories. May be worth a per-goal or annealed alpha floor.

findings.description: value_loss trends down to 0.00237 by the end (min 6.2e-7), and policy_loss trends negative (-0.097, min -0.36) as expected for SAC. No NaNs across any train/* metric over 18305 logged points.

Grasp reaches 0.9 at ~5k episodes (paper ON_TRACK: 20-50k) and grow_plants reaches 0.9 at ~38k episodes (paper ON_TRACK: 80-120k). Both are notably ahead of the paper's reported schedule, though grow_plants' subsequent instability tempers this.

Neither grow_herbivores nor grow_carnivores has shown sustained progress by 223k episodes, while the paper's ON_TRACK window has herbivores rising at 60-80k and reaching 0.5 by 150-175k. This run is well past that window with no signal.
findings.recommendation: If this persists past 300k episodes, treat it as a real regression versus the paper rather than run-length variance, and check goal_sampler LP weighting and the alpha collapse noted above as likely contributors.

paper_vs_run: This run is faster than the paper on the easy goals (grasp, grow_plants) but is lagging badly on the two harder categories (grow_herbivores, grow_carnivores) relative to the paper's reported timeline, and shows instability (repeated grow_plants collapses, premature alpha collapse, and a still-undifferentiated SR estimate for impossible goals) that the paper's MAGELLAN curves do not exhibit at this stage.
